name: one-signal-codex
description: Trace OpenAI Codex CLI sessions to your One Infra organization via One Connector.

interface.shortDescription: Trace Codex CLI sessions to your One Infra org
interface.longDescription: Uploads each completed OpenAI Codex CLI turn — model generations, tool calls, reasoning summaries, and token usage/cost — to your One Infra organization via One Connector, so Codex sessions render in Console Observe alongside your Claude Code sessions. Only a One Connector access token lives on the developer's machine.
